rollupRule.declaredIn: S0 Unit 2, before any Unit 5 measurement (council C8)
rollupRule.inclusionWindow: obs timestamp floored to the hour; obs at minute >= 45 roll into the following hour
rollupRule.stateVariableRollup: nearest-to-bin-centre single observation, never a mean
rollupRule.precipitationRollup: last non-null hourly-accumulation report in the bin (NOT summed — the field is already an hour accumulation)
rollupRule.gapHandling: a bin with no admissible observation is MISSING; never interpolated, never defaulted to zero
rollupRule.qcNote: Z (preliminary) is admitted but tagged; Unit 5 reports the V/Z split so the reader can discount accordingly
rollupRule.dstHandling: align in UTC; convert to site-local via the IANA zone only at the estimator's night-window boundary
